voice.headingCase: ALL-CAPS for display / headline / title / label; mixed case for body / lead / link.
voice.headingTracking: 0.02em on display caps; 0.08em on label-size caps.
voice.ctaVoice: Short imperative caps: BROWSE MORE SERVICES, REQUEST SERVICE, CREDIT APP, NEW QUOTE, SHOP USED, RENT NOW.
dos: Use short imperative verb-led CTA labels (CREDIT APP, REQUEST SERVICE).
Use ALL-CAPS for display / headline / title / label only.
Include the HQ phone in the utility bar on every page.
Group sentiment + proof into one band; do not orphan section heads.
Use narrative proofs ('18 branches across...') over floating numerals.
donts: Don't use editorial register vocabulary (atelier, studio, journal).
Don't write sentence-case section heads — the brand voice is signage caps.
Don't carousel the finance offers — show them all above the fold.
Don't float numerals as a stat row — narrative only.
Don't drop the utility-bar phone on any variant.

narrative.overview: Wheeler Cat is a regional Caterpillar dealer; the brand reads like the plate on a piece of Cat equipment — condensed caps stamped on a yellow ground, engineering precision, no decoration. The redesign is brand-faithful (Mode A): palette and typography pinned to the captured surface; composition discipline, density discipline, and (in variant C) motion choreography lets the signage register perform.
keyCharacteristics: Cat-Yellow primary palette pinned to the captured surface (no invented colors)
Roboto Condensed display + Roboto body, modular scale at 1.250 (major third)
5px primary radius retained from captured site
Section padding capped at 64px desktop (multi-audience density floor)
Image-reuse contract: captured photography reused at semantic position
Three variant slots: A faithful + improvements · B yellow-as-surface · C kinetic-display

rules.name: The Cat-Yellow Voice Rule
rules.body: Cat Yellow is the brand's signature gesture, not a CTA pigment. Every yellow appearance must be load-bearing.

rules.name: The Pure-Color Retention Rule
rules.body: #FFFFFF and #272727 are retained verbatim under Mode A brand-faithful inversion.

rules.name: The Modular-Scale Rule
rules.body: Every heading size is a step in the 1.250 (major third) scale — 16/20/25/31/39/49/61 px. No ad-hoc sizing.

rules.name: The Tracking-By-Weight Rule
rules.body: Display caps tracked at 0.02em; label caps at 0.08em; body normal. No ad-hoc per-element tracking.

rules.name: The All-Caps Retention Rule
rules.body: ALL-CAPS retained on H1/H2/H3 — the brand voice IS signage. Mixed case reserved for body / lead / link.

rules.name: The Color-Block-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from yellow-vs-dark-vs-stone color blocking, not from gradient or soft shadow effects.

dos: Do use Cat Yellow as a load-bearing brand surface (CTA, hero ground in B, service-tile ground in B, eyebrow band).
Do use Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS for display heads; track at 0.02em; size from the 1.250 modular scale only.
Do preserve the captured 5px primary radius on cards, buttons, inputs, tiles.
Do reuse captured images at semantic position.
Do group sentiment + partner proof into one band and locations + branch list into one band — no orphan headings.
Do require alt text on every image.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on variant C.
Do cap section padding at 64px desktop / 48px tablet / 32px mobile.
donts: Don't spread Cat Yellow as decoration.
Don't use Slick.js or any draggable carousel above the fold for finance offers.
Don't render the 18/75/24 floating-numerals stat row.
Don't invent a font outside the captured surface.
Don't invent a color outside the captured palette.
Don't drop the utility-bar phone on any variant.
Don't push section padding above 64px desktop, even on the highest-divergence variant.
Don't apply gradient text, glassmorphism, or side-stripes.
